report:
Freshly reviewed the complete candidate_completeness claim, all six ordinary implementation associations and the sole explicit TODO test. Captured current module expansion/completeness helpers as a whole file rather than retaining shifted/truncated line fragments, anti-unification, builtin derive support, metadata-provider contract, solver guide and both architectural rationales. An out-of-bounds initial module range was rejected and replaced with that whole-file capture. No production edits.

The claim requires the local compilation plus reachable dependency metadata, fixed-trait primary lookup, conservative self-head refinement retaining blanket/unclassified cases, and incomplete sources preventing exhaustive No. clauses.rs assemble_candidates includes matching environment facts, tracks incomplete assumptions, and retains uncertainty for unknown self shapes or missing/ineligible trait signatures. Ordinary traits request trait-keyed local candidates and, for external traits, external candidates optionally refined by a coarse self head. Missing/ineligible impl signatures propagate incompleteness. Structural Sized/MetaSized candidates remain separate; ordinary operator traits are not synthesized here. The orphan shortcut requires a foreign trait with no trait arguments and a definitely non-fundamental foreign nominal self; unavailable metadata does not authorize pruning.

impls.rs local_impl_candidates scans expanded local modules under a fixed trait query, retaining matching impl identities and marking unresolved headers, unsupported transformations and expansion hazards incomplete. It does not implement the separately planned private local index; the captured RFD explicitly retains that incremental work. Module completeness checks conservatively retain failed/unresolved/depth-limited item macros and relevant unsupported derives. An unrelated known builtin derive can be complete for a different hygienic trait, while unresolved derive identities remain incomplete. The current symbol_local_item visibility change does not alter these checks.

external_syms.rs preserves provider completeness, returns empty-incomplete on unavailable data, and downgrades wrongly tagged impl identities. Its self simplifier leaves aliases/parameters/unknown shapes unrefined. The rustc bridge requests all_impls for the fixed trait, excludes rustc-local identities owned by Sage source, retains unclassifiable/blanket heads and removes only classified unequal heads, then sorts/deduplicates identities. Its classifier returns None for parameter/alias and unsupported forms. It withholds completeness for auto traits and unmodeled builtin sources, with explicit operator impls and the rigid-ADT Iterator case handled deliberately. The captured TcxDb interface states the same conservative provider contract. This is inspection of source behavior, not an independent proof of external metadata exhaustiveness.

prove.rs carries candidate completeness through isolated proof execution to merge_candidate_results. merge.rs emits No only with no surviving Yes/Maybe and a complete source; otherwise anti_unify.rs adds an unconstrained possible source and returns conservative Maybe. A genuinely unconditional Proven answer can establish Yes without exhaustive enumeration, which does not manufacture a negative conclusion or a type-valued result.

The sole associated solver_candidate_completeness test is assertion-free TODO. It explicitly retains local/upstream/blanket/unclassifiable fixtures, unrelated trait/disjoint head exclusion, indexed-versus-exhaustive canonical response equivalence, incomplete-source negative prevention and primitive operator metadata provenance. Prerequisites are source/dependency fixtures, an exhaustive comparison observation path and query/provenance assertions. Nearby tests are not silently counted as associated evidence, and inspection does not discharge these runtime comparisons. No N/A entries apply.

No behavior tests were executed for this anchor review, because its only associated test is deferred; commands used were review start/read and source inspection before recording. Every implementation entry and qualification is accounted for, with the explicit verification TODO preserved. No additional edits requested.
